# New Tab Mii Plaza

> A browser extension for Chrome and Firefox that replaces the new tab page with a recreation of the Wii U's Wara Wara Plaza: up to ten pinned sites float around the edge as blocks, and Miis stand and walk in the middle. Free and open source (AGPL-3.0), made by Ankush Singh. A fan project, not affiliated with Nintendo.

## Pages

- [Home and install](https://ankush.one/newtab-mii-plaza/): download links, install steps and common questions
- [Support](https://ankush.one/newtab-mii-plaza/support/): controls, fixes for common problems and where to report bugs
- [Privacy policy](https://ankush.one/newtab-mii-plaza/privacy/): what is stored and where
- [Everything above in one file](https://ankush.one/newtab-mii-plaza/llms-full.txt)

## What it does

- Pin up to ten sites. Each block shows the site's icon and colour, fetched from the site once when pinned, or a PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG or animated GIF you choose. Right-click a block to edit it, click it to open the site.
- Add Miis by dropping in pictures of 3DS or Wii U Mii QR codes in Settings > Miis. The codes are read in the browser and never uploaded. Miis can be picked up and thrown.
- Settings (the gear, or the ? key) has light, dark and automatic themes, an optional clock, Mii voices on or off, drag to reorder blocks, and export or import of pins as JSON.
- The plaza stops drawing after five minutes without input, and a tab hidden for three minutes frees its graphics memory.

## Install

- Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi: download the Chrome zip from https://github.com/ankushKun/newtab-mii-plaza/releases/latest, unzip it, then Load unpacked in chrome://extensions with Developer mode on.
- Firefox 128 or newer: download the Firefox zip and use Load Temporary Add-on in about:debugging#/runtime/this-firefox. Firefox removes it on restart until the add-on is listed on Firefox Add-ons.
- Safari and phones are not supported.

## Privacy

- No account, ads, analytics or tracking.
- Pins and settings sync through the browser's own account (storage.sync). Miis and custom images stay on the device.
- The only requests it makes are for a site's title and icon when it is pinned, and https://ankush.one/announcement.json at most every six hours, without cookies.
